accepted_architecture: ROM <-> external sidecar child <-> authenticated nonsecret control <-> launcher-owned coop_sidecar::realtime core <-> cloud
decisions: Add a launcher realtime module that composes RealtimeEndpoint, RealtimeGrant, RealtimeOwner, RealtimeOwnerEvent, and run_realtime; never duplicate the WebSocket transport.
Use the existing no-redirect ReqwestCloudApi transport for authenticated POST v1/realtime/tickets with a dedicated small response bound.
Derive exactly ws:// or wss:// plus /v1/realtime from the already validated HTTP(S) base rather than accepting a second arbitrary endpoint.
Use an additive realtime API trait so existing CloudApi fakes and checkpoint behavior remain source compatible.
Wait indefinitely for the first validated local presence state before minting a ticket; continue coalescing state while minting and use the freshest state for the initial WebSocket frame.
Build the RuntimeLeaseFence from the active lease and canonical manifest target, require exact matches_request correlation, then consume into_parts and move the ticket into RealtimeGrant.
Allow exactly one new mint after an explicit Unauthorized plus successful auth refresh. Never retry an ambiguous transport, protocol, capacity, or cloud failure.
Run one continuously draining authenticated control I/O owner with critical-priority writes, latest-state coalescing, bounded interactions and transient lifecycle output.
PRESENCE_READY stays launcher-internal. Only Spawn, Update, and Despawn lifecycle records cross local control to the sidecar.

Any core terminal, full must-deliver queue, authenticated control loss, sidecar child exit, or RomPresenceReset at any lifecycle point is session-fatal. No in-session mint after reset, remint, or reconnect.
Checkpoint and shutdown must retain their correlation, reserved capacity, and absolute deadlines under sustained presence traffic; stop the realtime core before authenticated child shutdown.
Save revision changes alone do not restart presence.
first_unit_purpose: Implement canonical endpoint derivation, bounded authenticated mint HTTP, exact response-to-grant correlation, and stable error mapping without depending on the pending control protocol changes.
second_unit_purpose: Own the bounded control pump, realtime coordinator, checkpoint/shutdown coexistence, reset policy, and executable session activation after the sidecar control ABI lands.
compile_hazards: ControlChannel currently owns one unsplit TcpStream and is synchronously borrowed by checkpoint and shutdown flows.
SessionLifecycle checkpoint waits currently stop ordinary control polling.
ControlEvent and ControlCommand exhaustive matches in launcher production code and test fakes must be updated with the new typed variants.
The external sidecar remains the only ROM BridgeWriter; the launcher must never frame or write ROM messages itself.
The ticket is non-Clone and zeroizing; correlation must occur before the consuming into_parts call.
Production remains inactive unless main.rs calls the additive realtime lifecycle entry point.
